name: Cheez-It Original Baked Snack Crackers
whyItWorks: Baked with real skim milk cheese and enriched flour. With only 1g fiber and light salt, they offer savory satisfaction without grease or roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a single 1-oz serving (about 27 crackers). Chew until soft.
watchOuts: Contains wheat and dairy; moderate fat content (8g) is safe for remission and mild recovery.
